purpose: First-hours emergency monitoring package for the user-approved 100 percent cutover path.

rollout.trafficScope: all Taliya-owned commercial leads from widget and Taliya-owned WhatsApp after approval

featureFlag.rollbackExpectedDisposition: operational fallback or retryable spec011_core_disabled; never old TS v2 or Python runner commercial answering

monitors.title: Trace quality
monitors.source: Spec 011 trace record, /v1/taliya-commercial/turn response trace_id, and trace export reports
healthyCriteria: 100 percent of normal commercial turns have a non-empty trace_id.
100 percent of sampled traces have trace_complete=true and include input, decision, validation, render, usage, runtime diff, delivery events, and Sales Inbox projection.
No trace uses legacy runner evidence as the active production path.
abortCriteria: Any normal commercial turn has no trace_id.
Any sampled trace lacks decision, validator_result, model_usage, runtime_state_diff, delivery_events, or sales_inbox_projection.
Any active production trace references old TS v2 or runtime/runner.py commercial answering.
monitors.operatorAction: Disable TALIYA_SPEC011_COMMERCIAL_CORE_ENABLED=false, preserve failing trace ids, export the report, and stop activation review.

monitors.title: Human handoff pause and resume
monitors.source: runtime response output.handoff, delivery_control, runtime_state_diff, and Sales Inbox projection
healthyCriteria: Human-active state returns no AI commercial reply.
Handoff requested records structured reason and operator next action.
Resume occurs only after explicit state/event evidence.
abortCriteria: Any human-active conversation receives an AI commercial reply.
Any handoff request lacks reason, pause evidence, or Sales Inbox operator action.
Any resume occurs without explicit state/event evidence.
monitors.operatorAction: Rollback the flag, assign the conversation to human handling, and attach the trace/projection to the incident note.

monitors.title: Sales Inbox projection completeness
monitors.source: trace.sales_inbox_projection and Sales Inbox persisted projection/export
healthyCriteria: Every sampled normal turn has a Sales Inbox projection tied to the same conversation_id.
Completed diagnostic, waitlist, demo/product follow-up, and handoff cases include their required case-family fields.
Identity/contact fields keep customer, channel, operator, inferred, or unverified labels.
abortCriteria: Any sampled normal turn has missing or mismatched Sales Inbox projection.
Any completed diagnostic projection lacks final recommendation, plan/range, or final demo line.
Any inferred/contact value is promoted as reliable without source labels.
monitors.operatorAction: Rollback the flag if projection is missing/wrong for production traffic, then preserve the trace and projection JSON for repair.

monitors.title: Model usage present for normal commercial turns
healthyCriteria: 100 percent of normal commercial turns have model, input_tokens, output_tokens, and cost_usd.
Widget and Taliya-owned WhatsApp both record model usage.
Low cost is not achieved by bypassing the LLM conductor.
abortCriteria: Any normal commercial turn has zero or missing model usage.
Any commercial turn answers price, demo, diagnostic, waitlist, product, source, pain, or mixed intent without model usage.
Cost drops to near zero because the conductor was bypassed.
monitors.operatorAction: Rollback the flag and inspect adapter/conductor routing before re-enabling.

monitors.title: Cost and token envelope
monitors.source: runtime response output.usage, trace.model_usage, and cost report gate
healthyCriteria: Aggregate cost remains inside the approved first-hours budget.
Per-turn cost spikes are reviewed against trace quality and model usage.
Cost reduction never removes conductor usage from commercial turns.
abortCriteria: Aggregate cost exceeds the approved first-hours budget.
Any runaway retry/repair loop is visible in usage or error logs.
Any cost-saving behavior correlates with missing model usage or bad transcript quality.
monitors.operatorAction: Rollback the flag, preserve usage export, and block activation until cost report is reviewed.

monitors.title: Fallback and error rate
monitors.source: runtime status, API error codes, operational fallback reasons, and trace validation failures
healthyCriteria: Fallback/error rate remains below 5 percent after excluding intentional rollback tests.
No fallback contains deterministic commercial answer copy.
Every fallback/error includes channel, conversation id, request id, and reason.
abortCriteria: Fallback/error rate reaches 5 percent or more across the first-hours sample.
Any fallback answers price, demo, diagnostic, waitlist, product, source, pain, or mixed intent deterministically.
Any fallback/error lacks reason or request/conversation scope.
monitors.operatorAction: Rollback the flag, export fallback/error cases, and keep public old brain quarantined.

monitors.title: Duplicate and interleaved delivery
monitors.source: idempotency keys, delivery_events, outbox reservations, deferred inbound records, and provider message ids
healthyCriteria: Duplicate inbound idempotency returns the existing turn/result.
Inbound received during active delivery is deferred and processed as the next clean turn.
No duplicated or interleaved outbound chunks appear in sampled widget or WhatsApp conversations.
abortCriteria: Any duplicated public response for the same inbound idempotency key.
Any lead message during chunks is treated as a new commercial intent before active delivery completes.
Any WhatsApp delivery violates the approved text/chunk rules.
monitors.operatorAction: Rollback the flag, preserve idempotency/outbox evidence, and pause affected conversations if needed.

monitors.title: Observed P0 behavior
monitors.source: P0 real-model/eval reports, sampled production traces, rendered messages, and Sales Inbox projection
healthyCriteria: No internal text leak appears in rendered messages.
No wrong product fact, price/student-count mixup, skipped urgency, repeated answered diagnostic question, duplicate delivery, or false PASS appears in the watch sample.
Any P0 observation triggers immediate abort review.
abortCriteria: Any P0 abort criterion fires once.
Any eval/report says PASS while the transcript violates a P0 rule.
Any rendered message contains internal/source/debug wording.
monitors.operatorAction: Rollback immediately, preserve the transcript/trace/report, and do not re-enable until the P0 has a red-first regression and fix.

monitors.title: Rollback readiness
monitors.source: T011-098 rollback report, feature flag config, public fallback quarantine, and runner quarantine
healthyCriteria: Rollback report stays green immediately before activation.
Public old TS v2 and Python runner commercial paths remain quarantined.
Rollback returns operational fallback/error, not commercial copy.
abortCriteria: Rollback report fails.
Public path can reach old TS v2 or runtime/runner.py commercial answering.
Rollback cannot be executed within 5 minutes of abort decision.
monitors.operatorAction: Do not activate, or rollback immediately if already activated; rerun rollback/quarantine reports before any retry.

p0AbortCriteria.abortIf: Rendered output includes internal/source/debug wording such as profile reliability labels, site-source internals, trace ids, policy text, or implementation notes.
Rendered output invents or misstates price, plan, checkout, launch date, discount, VIP, integration, certification, demo availability, or product capability.
A price is interpreted as active students, a student count is interpreted as price, a phone/date is treated as plan data, or an unknown number is advanced without evidence.
The agent marks diagnostic complete or delivers final diagnostic while mandatory questions, especially urgency, are missing.
The same inbound produces duplicate public replies or a new inbound during chunks is processed before the active delivery completes.
The AI sends any commercial reply while human handoff is active or resumes without explicit event/state evidence.
Sales Inbox projection is missing, mismatched to conversation, incomplete for the case family, or promotes inferred identity/contact facts as reliable.
An eval/report marks PASS while transcript, trace, model usage, validator result, delivery event, or Sales Inbox projection evidence is missing or contradictory.

requiredEvidence.why: Proves delivery suppression, trace/projection evidence, model usage, and no live-state mutation in shadow mode.
Compares decision JSON, rendering, usage, trace, and projection against manual review samples.
Proves disabling the core returns operational fallback/error and does not reactivate legacy commercial brains.
Proves runtime API/core public path does not call runtime/runner.py for commercial answering.
Proves public widget/WhatsApp entrypoints cannot reach old TS v2 commercial modules.
Proves widget cutover work did not introduce protected /pilates visual/layout drift.

operatorActions.action: Before activation, rerun static, rollback, quarantine, shadow, watch-readiness, TypeScript, and focused runtime suites.
Within 5 minutes, sample widget and Taliya-owned WhatsApp turns for trace_id, model usage, delivery events, and Sales Inbox projection.
Set TALIYA_SPEC011_COMMERCIAL_CORE_ENABLED=false, preserve reports/traces/transcripts, and stop production activation review.
After 240 minutes, attach reports, sampled traces, Sales Inbox exports, cost summary, fallback/error summary, and product-owner approval decision.
